## Load packages

```{r init}
require("RPostgres", quietly = TRUE)
require("sqldf", quietly = TRUE)
library("sp", quietly = TRUE)
library("rgdal", quietly = TRUE)
library("sf", quietly = TRUE)
library("tmap", quietly=TRUE)
library(hydroloom) # working with river networks(bifurcations etc.)
library(tidyverse)
```

# Load rawdata(inspire hydrographic network) 

```{r}

# Connect to EDA database
EDA_con <- dbConnect(drv = Postgres(), 
                     dbname = "eda2.4",
                     user="postgres",
                     password="postgres")
```

##Extract data from inspire network
```{sql, connection="EDA_con", output.var = "rn"}
#| engine: knitr

WITH swe AS 
(SELECT * -- network excluding segments in the sea
FROM 
alt_insp.watercourselink w
WHERE NOT isinsea),
snode_not_in_endnode AS
(SELECT s1.startnode
FROM swe s1
EXCEPT 
SELECT s2.endnode
FROM swe s2),
issource_ids AS(
SELECT gml_id
FROM
alt_insp.watercourselink w2 
WHERE w2.startnode IN (SELECT * FROM snode_not_in_endnode))
SELECT s.*, 
CASE 
WHEN i.gml_id IS NULL THEN FALSE
ELSE TRUE END issource 
FROM swe s
LEFT JOIN issource_ids i
ON s.gml_id=i.gml_id
WHERE maincatchment = 92000;
```

# Use hydroloom 
```{r}

# Create an sf-object(spatial feature object)
rn_sf <- rn %>% mutate(geom=st_as_sfc(wkb_geometry))
rn_sf <- st_as_sf(rn_sf)

# Create hydroloom-object
hnames <- c(gml_id="id",length="lengthm") # hydroloom need to define names for ids etc.
hydroloom_names(hnames,clear=FALSE)
rn_hy <- hy(rn_sf)

#flow_net <- temp_rn |>
#             sf::st_transform(5070)        

flow_net <- rn_hy |>
  make_attribute_topology(min_distance = 5) |> # maximum distance between end and startnodes
  make_node_topology(add_div = TRUE) |>
  left_join(rn_hy, by = "id")


outlets <- filter(flow_net, issea)

non_dendr_netw <- add_divergence(flow_net, 
               coastal_outlet_ids = outlets$id, 
               inland_outlet_ids = c(), 
               name_attr = "fk_gml_id_wcls", 
               type_attr = "fictitious", 
               major_types = unique(flow_net$fictitious)) |>
  add_toids(return_dendritic = FALSE) |>
  add_return_divergence(status = TRUE)

# exclude non dendritic paths
dendr_netw <- add_divergence(flow_net, 
               coastal_outlet_ids = outlets$id, 
               inland_outlet_ids = c(), 
               name_attr = "fk_gml_id_wcls", 
               type_attr = "fictitious", 
               major_types = unique(flow_net$fictitious)) |>
  add_toids(return_dendritic = TRUE) 

```

## Plot network
```{r}

# make spatial object of dendritic and nondendritic networks
nond_sf <- st_as_sf(non_dendr_netw)
dend_sf <- st_as_sf(dendr_netw)

# plot nondendritic network with divergences
tmap_mode("view") 
tm_basemap(server='https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png') +
tm_shape(nond_sf) +
    tm_lines(col="return_divergence",
               palette = c("white","black"),
           lwd=3) +
tm_shape(nond_sf) +
    tm_lines(col="divergence", 
           lwd=3,
           palette=c(palette = c("white","green", "red")),
           alpha=0.5) +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Non dendritic network", main.title.position = "center")

# plot
tmap_mode("view") 
tm_basemap(server='https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png') +
tm_shape(nond_sf) + 
  tm_lines(col="red",lwd=1) +
tm_shape(dend_sf) +
  tm_lines(col="green",lwd=1) +
tm_shape(sub_st_sf) +
  tm_lines(col="black",lwd=1)
```
